opportunities.name: Plan a family call and draft an email with local time and forecast
opportunities.description: For a relative living in a given city, look up the current local time and time offset on timeanddate, check the 10-day forecast on weather.com for the call day, then draft an email to family@example.com summarising both.
steps: On timeanddate, search for {city} and open the matching city result
Note the local time, timezone abbreviation and the offset from Lille
On weather.com, open location search, type {city} and pick the matching suggestion
Open the '10 Day' forecast and read the {day} conditions, high/low and chance of rain
In mail, compose a new message to {recipient}
Set Body to 'Calling {relative} on {day}. It is {local_time} {tz} in {city} now ({offset} Lille), forecast there: {conditions} {day}, high {high}, low {low}, {rain}% chance of rain.'

opportunities.name: Research a weekend stopover city and book-scout a hotel
opportunities.description: For a given French city and date, look up the city on Wikipedia (main sight, population), search Booking.com for a one-night stay on those dates, open a hotel, and save a stopover note.
steps: On Wikipedia, search for {city} and open the article; note the population and a main sight
On Booking.com, clear the destination box, type {city} and choose the matching suggestion
Open the date picker and go to the month of {checkin_date}
Select {checkin_date} as check-in and the next day as check-out, then click Search
Open the chosen hotel from the results and note its price

instances.values: city=Dijon, dates=Nov 21–22 2026, hotel=Aparthotel Adagio Access Dijon République €69
city=Reims, dates=Dec 19–20 2026, hotel=Best Western Premier Hotel de la Paix €204

opportunities.name: Dinner options: eat out vs cook at home
opportunities.description: Search for a restaurant by cuisine and London area, then search Allrecipes for a matching dish and save a note comparing the restaurant (rating, price, area) with the recipe (total time).
steps: On the restaurant site, clear the search box, type '{cuisine} {area}' and submit
Open the top restaurant's details and note its rating and price range
On Allrecipes, click search, type {dish} and submit
Open the top-rated matching recipe and note its total time
In notes, add 'Dinner: out at {restaurant} ({rating}, {price}, {area}) or cook {recipe} ({total_time})'

instances.values: cuisine=Italian, area=Islington, dish=lasagna → Terra Rossa - Angel / Creamy Chicken Lasagna
cuisine=Thai, area=Soho, dish=pad thai → Thai Tho - Soho / Pad Thai
cuisine=Indian, area=Shoreditch, dish=chicken tikka masala → SPICE SLICE Shoreditch / Chicken Tikka Masala
